create_dynamic_protobuf_class: create a dynamic protobuf message class from a dict of field names and field types using MakeSimpleProtoClass
build_named_protobuf_class: build a named protobuf class with a fully qualified name and custom DescriptorPool via MakeSimpleProtoClass
create_anonymous_protobuf_class: create an anonymous protobuf class with auto-generated hash-based name from a fields dictionary
